newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sept JGBs set new contract high by Tokyo close.
newsitem.headline: Sept JGBs set new contract high by Tokyo close.

text.p: The key September JGB futures contract set a new lifetime high by the Tokyo close on Friday, aided by a weak Tokyo share market and talk that influential financier Geroge Soros was boosting his long positions in JGB futures, traders said.
"There was widespread talk that Soros was boosting his JGB positions (on the Tokyo Stock Exchange), while liquidating his positions in Tokyo stock futures on SIMEX," a European bank trader said.
September JGBs set a new contract high of 126.77 in the afternoon before closing at 126.67, up from Thursday's 126.45.
The key bond yield fell as low as 2.085 percent, nearly reaching the all-time low of 2.075 percent set on April 8.

JGB futures fell on LIFFE overnight after a comment by Keidanren Chairman Shoichiro Toyoda on Thursday that the Japanese economy appears to be improving and that it may be time to raise the official discount rate.
Keidanren is a powerful Japanese business lobby.
